name: legitirank-ai
description: I am starting this project to combat the growing misuse and manipulation of SEO (Search Engine Optimization). I feel like search algorithm manipulation is a growing problem and I am trying to re-establish a cleaner, more trustworthy search engine experience. I understand that this problem will probably grow alongside, or leapfrog with, the solution, but perhaps now is a good time to get the process started. This response is not intended to combat SEO itself, only the misuse and manipulation of SEO to promote illegitimate rankings.
